name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to small and marginal farmers, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 each
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land up to 2 hectares. Family (husband, wife, minor children) owns agricultural land.
how_to_apply: Apply at CSC (Common Service Centre), Agriculture Department office, or online at pmkisan.gov.in

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization
eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 database. Karnataka has additional coverage through Arogya Karnataka.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest empanelled hospital

name: PM Awas Yojana (Gramin)
description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for rural BPL families
eligibility: Homeless or families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses. SC/ST, minorities, and persons with disability given priority.
benefit_amount: ₹1.2 lakh in plain areas / ₹1.3 lakh in hilly/difficult areas
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or online at pmayg.nic.in

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small savings scheme for girl children providing high interest rate and tax benefits to secure daughter's future
eligibility: Girl child below 10 years of age. Account opened in the name of the girl child by guardian.
benefit_amount: 8.2% interest per annum (revised quarterly). Tax-free maturity.
how_to_apply: Open account at Post Office or authorized bank (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, etc.)
deadline: Account can be opened any time before girl turns 10

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans to micro and small businesses for manufacturing, trading, and service sector enterprises
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. Individual, partnership firms, and companies eligible.
benefit_amount: Shishu: up to ₹50,000 | Kishore: ₹50,001–5 lakh | Tarun: ₹5–10 lakh
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, MFI, or online at mudra.org.in

name: National Pension System (NPS)
description: Voluntary retirement savings scheme with market-linked returns, tax benefits, and flexible withdrawal options
eligibility: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 70 years of age
benefit_amount: Market-linked returns. Tax deduction up to ₹2 lakh under 80C + additional ₹50,000 under 80CCD(1B)
how_to_apply: Open account at bank, post office, or online at enps.nsdl.com

name: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
description: Scholarships for children of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) and Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel
eligibility: Children of ex-servicemen / widows of CAPF & RPF personnel. Minimum 60% marks required.
how_to_apply: Apply online at ksb.gov.in during scholarship window (usually July–October)

name: Disability Pension Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe disabilities unable to earn livelihood, provided by Karnataka government
eligibility: Karnataka resident, disability of 40% or more certified by medical authority, income below poverty line
how_to_apply: Apply at Taluk Social Welfare Office or through Seva Sindhu portal

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for elderly Below Poverty Line (BPL) citizens under the National Social Assistance Programme
eligibility: Age 60 and above. BPL family as per state list. No other pension income.
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat/Ward Office or through state portal

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Seed funding support of up to ₹50 lakh for early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, and market entry
eligibility: DPIIT recognized startup, incorporated not more than 2 years ago, not received funding from other scheme
benefit_amount: Grants up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept. Convertible debt up to ₹50 lakh for market entry.
deadline: Rolling — check portal for incubator openings

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Loanee farmers enrolled automatically.
benefit_amount: Full insured sum for crop loss. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops
how_to_apply: Apply through bank, CSC, or PMFBY portal. Loanee farmers automatically enrolled.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Cash incentive scheme to promote institutional delivery among pregnant women below poverty line
eligibility: Pregnant women aged 19+ years, BPL families, SC/ST households. Government or accredited private facility delivery.
how_to_apply: Register at nearest government health centre or ANM (Accredited Social Health Activist)
deadline: Apply during pregnancy. Payment at time of delivery.
